name: lingoza
description: Lingoza — a complete Spanish learning ecosystem (A1 → C2) with one learning engine behind web, Telegram and mobile interfaces.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lingoza/engine && npm run build --workspace @lingoza/content && npm run build --workspace @lingoza/api && npm run build --workspace @lingoza/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/engine packages/content apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @lingoza/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
